en: The image on the front depicts a tranquil park with large, leafy trees and a path leading to a sizable building in the background. The building appears to be an institution or a large house, surrounded by benches and greenery. The back side of the postcard contains handwritten text in German, a German postage stamp, and printed details about the location: 'Erholungsheim St. Maria, Friedensthal/Bad Pyrmont - Ruf 20 53.' There are also museum and publisher stamps, and the recipient's address.
